notes.title: Update: June 13th 2024
notes.content: This patch has a number of text updates.

notes.title: Fixes for patch 29/02/2024
notes.content:
The following issues have been fixed:

1) In the infirmary, if you press "talk" and then hide the dialogue box and click anywhere on screen the dialogue will end as expected,  however the next time press the talk feature the game freezes
2) Chapter 2 endgame: I selected Spirit File while the "Hanako may appear at any moment" banner at the bottom was active and got a black screen that doesn't respond...
3) Entering the gameplay and proceeding to the help menu to check the controls, it is observed that a blank screen is displayed upon opening 'Controls - 1' and 'Controls - 2'.”

notes.title: 20/02/24 - Patch update notes
notes.content:
[b]Improved mouse controls around navigation[/b] – clicking the upper part of the screen now counts as an 'up' input, and will now enter the next area when a red interactive ‘up’ arrow is displayed, while clicking the lower portion of the screen now counts as a 'down' input, and will enter the next area when a red interactive ‘down’ arrow is displayed. Interacting with the 'white dot' interactive items when they're in line with  your character will work anywhere in the central portion of the display.

[b]Improved the movement of mouse and analog stick inputs during first person investigations.[/b] The movement here should now be much more fluid and not just 8-directional.

[b]Fixed a lockup that could occur when using the mouse to control the game while close to both an interactive ‘white dot’ object and an interactive ‘red arrow’ entrance to a new area[/b] (e.g. the lockups found in the restrooms near the cleaning cupboard and some classrooms near a cleaning cupboard, etc.)

[b]Fixed some text errors mentioned on the Steam discussions.

Resized the mouse pointer.[/b]
